# pulse_tag (Resource)

Manages one organization-scoped Pulse tag. Purpose is immutable; deletion is rejected while any configuration or operational record references the tag.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_order` (Number) Organization-defined display order.
- `name` (String) Organization-unique name within the selected purpose.
- `purpose` (String) Tag purpose: relevance or filter.

### Optional

- `display_label` (String) Optional human-readable display label.
- `icon` (String) Optional icon identifier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Pulse tag UUID.
- `revision` (Number) Configuration revision used for optimistic concurrency.
